A luminous golden crescent hangs HIGH above the valley in upper-right sky. Moonlight gently illuminates village roofs, stone bridge and the animals' homeward footpath. Bear, fox and ivory rabbit walk home peacefully, small figures, lower-left foreground. NO Jarvis on this opening page. Establish an unmistakable village-near / valley-far spatial relationship, watercolor moonlit sky taking upper half; ample near-white paper at edges and pale washes. Design a graceful new scene matching style reference; do not copy its seated guardian or lake scene. No fallen moon yet.
